{{Quote|First, you need to go to Trins Evnar's house and take his place. Be sure to collect as much data on him as you can while you're there.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vitala Baize|Baize]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TCCAI" />}}
'''Trins Evnar's House''' was a residential building located in the city of [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It was inhabited by [[Trins Evnar]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:TCCAI" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Corellian Security Force]] started an investigation against the Chirq Council.<ref name="SWG:TCCSC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: Seek Council|Corellia}}</ref> After the informant [[Lilith Laughlin]] revealed to the CorSec that Trins Evnar was a member of the Council, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vitala Baize]] hired a spacer to eliminate him in order to infiltrate the Chirq Council using Evnar's identity. The spacer thus fought Trins Evnar in his house and killed him. After his death, the spacer assumed Trins Evnar's identity towards the underboss [[Jzoro Quanera]] and managed to infiltrate the organization,<ref name="SWG:TCCMU">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "The Chirq Council: Moving Up" on Corellia</ref> leading to the destruction of the Chirq Council.<ref name="SWG:TCCTEC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: The Elite Council|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Trins Evnar's House appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TCCAI" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Trins Evnar's House was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
